rows.grounds: locus of offering; spelling as given in text

items.question: What purpose is achieved by offering everything to Brahman possessing qualities?
premises: The offering is directed to Brahman possessing qualities.
The stated purpose of this offering is the attainment of all prosperity.
items.inference: Offering everything to qualified Brahman brings about all prosperity.
uncertainties: The spelling vrahmaṇi for brahmaṇi is retained as given; intended referent is Brahman.
items.plain_english: Thus one should offer everything to Brahman with qualities, for the attainment of all prosperity.
